review.assessment: The change replaces a right-to-left accumulation loop with a left-to-right pass over operators and terms, ensuring addition and subtraction are evaluated in the correct order. This directly fixes the reported bug where chained subtractions like `10 - 3 - 2` incorrectly computed as `9` by evaluating the last operator first. Structural validation passed and the acceptance test for precedence/single-subtraction succeeded without regressions.
